title: ElectrolyteFM: Unifying Electrolyte Property Prediction through Cross-Property Knowledge Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.39340v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Electrolyte formulation design requires balancing multiple physicochemical properties, yet existing models often focus on a limited subset. Learning each property in isolation can overlook transferable chemical information, whereas indiscriminate sharing can introduce cross-property interference. Our directed transfer analysis shows that jointly learning two property prediction tasks can improve or degrade prediction relative to separate training, with asymmetric transfer effects between the tasks. We propose ElectrolyteFM, a unified multi-property prediction model which can more accurately predict multiple properties of each electrolyte by effectively identifying and utilizing property-specific features and knowledge shared across properties. translated_title: ElectrolyteFM：通过跨性质知识学习统一电解液性质预测
translated_abstract: 电解液配方设计需要平衡多种物理化学性质，然而现有模型往往仅关注有限的性质子集。孤立地学习每种性质可能会忽略可迁移的化学信息，而不加区分的知识共享则可能引入跨性质干扰。我们的有向迁移分析表明，联合学习两个性质预测任务相比单独训练可能提升也可能降低预测效果，且任务间存在不对称的迁移效应。我们提出了ElectrolyteFM，这是一个统一的多性质预测模型，通过有效识别和利用性质特定特征以及跨性质共享的知识，能够更准确地预测每种电解液的多种性质。更具体地说，ElectrolyteFM独立学习性质特定的表示，并通过单独训练的专家池捕获跨性质知识，再由路由器选择相关的共享知识……
tldr: 提出统一多性质预测模型ElectrolyteFM，通过独立学习性质特定表示、结合单独训练的专家池与路由机制捕获跨性质共享知识，解决了联合训练中跨性质干扰问题，实现电解液多种性质的更准确预测。
en_tdlr: ElectrolyteFM unifies multi-property electrolyte prediction by independently learning property-specific representations while capturing cross-property knowledge through a separately trained expert pool with a router, mitigating cross-property interference for more accurate multi-property predictions.
